source_repairs.what: First1KGreek encodes Lake's Latin (the Vulgate version L1, printed where the Greek is lost) in Greek letters (e.g. 'ποστ#3υαμ περσξριπσεραμ λιβρυμ ηυνξ' = 'Postquam perscripseram librum hunc'), with OCR slips. Latin spans were separated token by token from the accented Greek, restored to Latin letters by fixed letter mapping (ξ c, #3/θ q, ϝ v, χ x, Ω V ...), then every word was compared across three witnesses (that file and two independent Internet Archive OCRs of Lake vol. II, witness_A = apostolicfathers02lakeuoft, witness_B = TheApostolicFathersV2). 14 word slips and 3 punctuation slips were settled by majority (listed in 'corrections'); single-witness OCR slips where First1K agreed with the other OCR were kept as First1K ('kept'). Lake's capitalization was applied where both OCRs show it (85 sentence-initial words); spacing before ; : ? normalized; a soft hyphen and a stray combining breve removed. Real Greek left exactly as it was. Both sections stay under the key 'greek' because each still contains Greek.

corrections.note: word split at Lake's line-end hyphen
